gold.name: Gold
gold.description: Common coin of Aetheria. Used for upgrades and everyday purchases.

gems.name: Gems
gems.description: Rare crystalline currency. Premium purchases only after platform compliance is approved.

crystals.name: Summoning Crystals
crystals.description: Earned through play. Spent on character summons.

guild_tokens.name: Guild Tokens
guild_tokens.description: Earned through guild activity and spent in the guild shop.

ancient_coins.name: Ancient Coins
ancient_coins.description: Relics of a kingdom older than the six regions.

event_tokens.name: Event Tokens
event_tokens.description: Earned during live events and traded for limited rewards.

moonpetal.name: Moonpetal
moonpetal.description: A pale flower that only opens under a moonless sky. Used in ascension.

glade_sap.name: Glade Sap
glade_sap.description: Warm amber sap from the oldest trees of Greenward.

dew_of_awakening.name: Dew of Awakening
dew_of_awakening.description: Collected at dawn from the leaves of sleeping guardians.

gladewood_bow.name: Gladewood Bow
gladewood_bow.description: A living bow cut from a branch that agreed to be cut.

mossweave_vest.name: Mossweave Vest
mossweave_vest.description: Moss woven so tightly it remembers being bark.

wayfarer_charm.name: Wayfarer Charm
wayfarer_charm.description: A small wooden charm carved with a road that has no end.

sunfire_blade.name: Sunfire Blade
sunfire_blade.description: Forged in the last hour of a sun that no longer exists.

hollow_heart.name: Hollow Heart
hollow_heart.description: A seed from the Elder Hollow. It beats, faintly, when held.
